summary: Shared analysis service: text and geometry (pypdf), a rendered image of every page (PDFium, native), AES decryption (cryptography), page and document flags, and a full page inventory over source bytes; an evaluation wrapper with stdout/JSON separation; file-isolation tests. Model route: gateway client with route checks and a capped spend ledger, field candidates, stage A drafting and stage B self-check, a checker envelope, and a transport-level isolation test (no development-case inference yet).
